name: IRM Energy Ltd
title: IRM Energy Ltd - 544004 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: City gas distributor guides FY27 volume above 250 MMSCM (up from 223.67, 30%+ growth) and EBITDA/SCM up 10-15% from above INR 5, but Q4 PBT fell to INR 17.7 crore with NGT-linked industrial curbs unresolved.

capex.quote: this year, FY'27, we have planned exceeding INR 150 crore more in that particular GA

triggers.label: FY27 volume guided 250+ MMSCM
triggers.quote: we will be definitely crossing 250 or maybe more, maybe much more

triggers.label: Gas cost pass-through protects margin
triggers.quote: we were able to successfully pass on the resultant gas cost to the consumer, so we have protected our margin for this financial year as well

triggers.label: Industrial demand destruction from price rise
triggers.quote: since the prices have gone up, see, the demand itself has been shrinking a bit

triggers.label: Industrial gas supply cut to 55% of contract
triggers.quote: It came down to 80% of the daily contracted quantity and further went down up to 65 and then 55

triggers.label: EBITDA/SCM +10-15% next year
